newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Automation buys UNR division.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Automation buys UNR division.

text.p: Pinnacle Automation Inc said Thursday it acquired the Real Time Solutions Inc subsidiary of UNR Industries Inc for an undisclosed price.

Real Time Solutions is a software development company whose products facilitate filing of split-case orders at retail distribution operations, Pinnacle said. Real Time Solutions posted sales of $12 million in 1995.
The company will become part of Pinnacle's Distribution Logistics Group, which specializes in automated material flow systems for warehouse and distribution operations.
UNR stock closed up 1/8 Thursday at 6-1/4.
